name: app-6aa8df314a8c8191972239a4e1284810
description: CBS SAP AI lets authorized users query SAP Business One data, choose an organization and database agent, and create or update sales, purchasing, inventory, and payment documents.

interface.longDescription: CBS SAP AI lets authorized users query SAP Business One data, choose an organization and database agent, and create or update sales, purchasing, inventory, and payment documents.
capabilities: Create sales, purchasing, inventory, and payment documents
Manage organization, database, and agent context

positive.description: Run an authorized read-only SAP data lookup.
positive.prompt: Show the ten most recent sales orders with their customer and total.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching rows or a clear authorization or query-validation result without changing SAP data.

positive.prompt: Switch my active organization to the organization whose ID I provide.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the selected organization and the caller's role, or explains that the caller is not a member.

positive.description: Choose the SAP database agent for a session.
positive.prompt: For this session, use the connected SAP agent whose ID I provide.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the selected connected agent or returns a clear validation error.

positive.prompt: Create a sales order for customer CUS00823 with two units of item FGMMDG0064.
positive.expected_behavior: After validation, returns the created and verified SAP sales-order number and line summary.

positive.prompt: I confirm: record an incoming cash payment for customer CUS00823 using the amount and invoice allocation I provide.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the payment after supplied details are validated and returns its verified SAP document summary.

negative.description: Do not trigger for a general knowledge question.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between a sales order and an invoice?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke the plugin; answer from general knowledge without accessing SAP.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated public-web research.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke the plugin; public-web shopping is outside its SAP workflows.

negative.description: Do not trigger for an unsupported destructive request.
negative.prompt: Delete every sales order from last year.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke the plugin; it does not provide deletion tools for SAP documents.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of CBS SAP AI for querying SAP Business One and managing supported sales, purchasing, inventory, and payment documents.
